Indian Private Space Company Achieves Historic Milestone with Successful Launch

Hyderabad-based Skyroot Aerospace has successfully launched its maiden space mission, Vikram-1, marking a significant achievement for India's private space sector. The launch was hailed as a historic milestone by the Prime Minister and ISRO officials, who praised the company's efforts in revolutionizing India's space entrepreneurship.
